proposals.before: When Zhou Dewei of Jin struck Jin prefecture to aid Zhijun, Shihou crushed him at Mengkeng and was moved from Baoyi to Xuanyi.
proposals.after: When Zhou Dewei of Jin struck Jin prefecture to aid Zhijun, Shihou crushed him at Mengkeng and, for his merit, was appointed military governor of Baoyi and then transferred to Xuanyi.
proposals.reason: The Chinese distinguishes the appointment to Baoyi (遷保義軍節度使) from the subsequent transfer to govern Xuanyi (徙鎮宣義); the current wording incorrectly treats both as places of transfer.

proposals.before: As a youth he followed Ge Zhuang’s rise between Qing and Di. Later, when Zhuang was defense commissioner of Ru, he led troops north against the Shatuo and returned into Chang’an to attack Huang Chao.
proposals.after: As a youth he followed Zhuge Shuang’s rise between Qing and Di. Later, when Shuang was defense commissioner of Ru, he led troops north against the Shatuo and returned into Chang’an to attack Huang Chao.
proposals.reason: 諸葛爽 is the personal name Zhuge Shuang; the translation splits and mistransliterates it as Ge Zhuang and Zhuang.

proposals.after: Shuang’s army was beaten and surrendered to Chao, who made him military governor of Heyang.
proposals.reason: 爽 is the short form of Zhuge Shuang's name and should be rendered Shuang, not Zhuang.

proposals.after: Xie Yanzhang came from Xu Prefecture.
proposals.reason: Chinese 許州 is Xu Prefecture (around modern Xuchang), not 徐州 Xuzhou; the English conflates the two.

proposals.before: Xie Yanzhang was a native of Xuzhou.
proposals.after: Xie Yanzhang was a native of Xu Prefecture.
proposals.reason: Chinese 許州 is Xu Prefecture, not 徐州 Xuzhou.

proposals.before: In youth he served Ge Congzhou; Congzhou, pitying his keen intelligence, adopted him as a son and taught him the art of war; Congzhou placed a thousand coins in a large tray, arranged them in the formations of marching columns and squads, and showed him the rhythms of advance and retreat—Yanzhang mastered it all.
proposals.after: In youth he served Ge Congzhou; Congzhou, fond of his keen intelligence, adopted him as a son and taught him the art of war; Congzhou placed a thousand coins in a large tray, arranged them in the formations of marching columns and squads, and showed him the rhythms of advance and retreat—Yanzhang mastered it all.
proposals.reason: 憐 here means fond appreciation of the boy's wit, not pity; the idiomatic already has 'taken with'.

proposals.before: Under the Last Emperor he rose step by step to military governor of Kuangguo.
proposals.after: Under the Last Emperor he was repeatedly promoted and became military governor of the Kuangguo Army.
proposals.reason: 匡國軍節度使 is military governor of the Kuangguo Army; 'of Kuangguo' drops 軍 and 'rose step by step to' understates 累遷.

decisions.reason: 以功遷保義軍節度使 marks a merit appointment to Baoyi, and 徙鎮宣義 is a later transfer to Xuanyi; 'moved from Baoyi to Xuanyi' wrongly treats Baoyi as a prior post rather than the rewarded appointment.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以功遷保義軍節度使，徙鎮宣義

decisions.reason: 諸葛爽 is the compound-surname personal name Zhuge Shuang; splitting it as Ge Zhuang / Zhuang invents a wrong name, and the proposed idiomatic restores both the full and short forms.

The literal likewise misreads 諸葛爽 as Ge Zhuang and 爽 as Zhuang; Zhuge Shuang / Shuang matches the Chinese while leaving the Qing–Di, Ru defense commissionership, Shatuo, and Huang Chao material intact.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 少從諸葛爽起青、棣間，其後爽為汝州防禦使

decisions.reason: 爽 here is the given-name short form of 諸葛爽 and must be Shuang, not Zhuang; the rest of the idiomatic (defeat, surrender to Chao, Heyang jiedushi) already tracks the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 爽兵敗降巢，巢以爽為河陽節度使

decisions.reason: Both occurrences of 爽 in this sentence are the short name of Zhuge Shuang; replacing Zhuang with Shuang corrects the romanization without changing the military or appointment sense.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 爽兵敗降巢，巢以爽為河陽節度使

decisions.reason: 虔裕隨爽奔於梁 uses 爽 for Zhuge Shuang; Zhuang is a false reading, and Shuang is the required short form.
The literal’s Zhuang for 爽 is the same mistransliteration; Shuang restores the short name while Zhonghe 3, Sun Ru taking Heyang, and flight to Liang remain correct.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 中和三年，孫儒陷河陽，虔裕隨爽奔於梁

decisions.reason: 許州 is Xu Prefecture, not 徐州 Xuzhou; the idiomatic conflates a different prefecture, and Xu Prefecture restores the source place-name.
The literal’s Xuzhou likewise misreads 許州; native of Xu Prefecture matches the Chinese without other changes.
憐其敏惠, with 敏惠 as a praised quality, means fondness for the boy’s quick wit rather than pity; 'fond of' aligns with the idiomatic 'taken with' and removes the invented pity sense.
累遷匡國軍節度使 is already clear in 'rose step by step to military governor of Kuangguo'; adding Army and rephrasing the promotions is stylistic polish, not a semantic repair.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0002 shows English Ge Zhuang came only from splitting and mistransliterating 諸葛爽; the personal-name claim must read Zhuge Shuang while keeping zh, pinyin, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
Accepted r0002 likewise shows the alternate English Zhuang was only the bad short form of 爽; revise to Shuang without retracting the underlying short-name fact.
